When approaching a fight, press R, then switch to E to close the gap.
Once you land the stun, instantly switch to Q. The number of attacks you chain together before activating your empowered Q depends entirely on the target.
Against assassins or other soft moving targets, just do one Q attack before using your empowered Q.
For strong creatures and tanks, you can weave two Q attacks before powering up the Q, as they are tankier and slower.
